purpose: Outcome-blind, eight-leaf Ox Alpha transport successor. It is bound to the permanently closed v3 cap-1 root; GPT-5.6 remains primary.

failed_v3.source: The caller supplies the exact immutable v3 cap-1 root; no machine-specific path is recorded in the package.
failed_v3.failure: The v3 parent launcher timed out first; its already-started bridge child later sealed the sole cap-1 physical request as HTTP 524 after more than 100 seconds. No result was accepted and v3 is permanently closed.

transport_pilot.success_rule: Exactly three serial, distinct, schema-valid completions. Each has one logical request, exactly one physical 2xx HTTP attempt below 100 seconds, zero recovered failures, raw evidence, payload, bridge receipt, and a distinct session.
transport_pilot.failure_rule: After the launcher returns and a stable terminal bridge-failure seal proves process quiescence, a 524, non-2xx, recovery, second physical attempt, drift, duplicate session, or receipt permanently closes the fresh root. An outer timeout or absent/unstable terminal seal instead records an uncertain blocked root. No retry, escalation, paid route, DSPy, or human route follows.

execution.launch_gate: Fresh zero-cost catalog and usage proof plus reviewed shared cap-1 runtime are required before launch.

privacy.pilot: No HANNA labels, scores, correlations, rankings, or prose analysis are produced.
privacy.human_judging: Existing public HANNA inputs only; no new human judging.
privacy.remote: Nous receives the frozen public source and paired prompt, frozen task contract, eight requested questions, the active judge instruction, and strict response schema for one cell at a time.

interpretation_limits: This supplements and never replaces GPT-5.6.
A transport pass does not establish scoring or alignment performance.
